**Chinese name:** 格科微有限公司 (Gékēwēi)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The volume counterweight to OmniVision/SmartSens in domestic CIS — top-4 by unit shipments globally, 1.45 billion CIS units in 2025 — and a live experiment in whether a Chinese design house can run its own 12-inch specialty fab: FY2025 revenue ¥77.82亿 (+21.9%) but net profit collapsed to ¥0.51亿 as the Lingang line absorbed depreciation; September 2026 plan to raise ~¥4.2 billion more for capacity. H1 2026: revenue ¥41.53亿, net ¥7.3 million.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Smartphone/IoT automotive CIS and LCD/OLED display driver ICs, increasingly on its own 300mm line.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2003 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | High-volume CMOS image sensors (VGA–50MP) and display driver ICs |
| **Node Sophistication** | GalaxyCell 2.0 BSI platform (0.61–1.0µm pixels); world-first single-chip 0.61µm 50MP CIS; first domestic 12-inch LOFIC sensor (140dB, automotive) |
| **Entity List** | No |
